name: How do contractors make a drywall patch blend seamlessly with existing wall texture?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors make a drywall patch blend seamlessly with existing wall texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching wall texture requires using the right spray or hand-application technique that mirrors the original finish, such as orange peel, knockdown, or smooth skim coats. After the patch is taped, mudded, and sanded flush, the repair specialist applies joint compound formulated for texturing. Feathering the texture several inches beyond the patch boundary blends the new work into the existing wall. Once the texture dries, applying a primer coat ensures the final interior paint absorbs evenly without leaving dull spots or visible seams.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors blend patches by feathering joint compound past the repair edges, matching the texture style like orange peel or knockdown, and applying primer before paint.
